references.text: Luke 4:10 is a direct quote from Psalm 91:11, which states that God will command His angels to guard the believer in all his ways. The devil quotes this verse to tempt Jesus.
Psalm 91:12 continues the quotation used by the devil in Luke 4:11 and forms a unit with verse 11 regarding angelic protection.
Matthew 4:6 is the parallel passage where the devil quotes the same verse from Psalm 91:11 during the temptation of Jesus in the wilderness.
Hebrews 1:14 refers to angels as ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation, linking to the theme of angels commanded to protect God's people.
In Exodus 23:20, God promises to send an angel ahead of His people to guard them on their journey, a similar theme of God's protective angels underlying the quote in Luke 4:10.
